name: LLM serving (vLLM, OpenAI-compatible)
description: Serves one baked open-weights LLM with vLLM behind an OpenAI-compatible HTTP server, meant to run as a U11 Service replica (port 8000, health path /health). Licences: see kits/llm-serve/README.md.

verification.owner_decision: OWNER DECISION: a Service replica streams no batch result to compare, so redundancy sampling is off (sample_fraction 0). How, or whether, LLM serving is verified (for example canary prompts at temperature 0 compared by embedding cosine) is undecided.
